description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
Random init; prints task signatures and sample examples to learn the format.
One block attention only (no LN/MLP); one-hot token/key/query dims; each answer position points at its fixed prompt position.
Shared 11-dim position one-hots; answer slots hold -e_source and W_q=-beta flips them into queries (removes separate query dims).
Positions on a 2-D quarter-circle arc; answer slots at the antipode of their source angle, W_q=-beta flips them into queries. Tokens stay one-hot.
Token = one scalar (its index), position = 2-D arc. Output h = current + 28*copied; head decodes the high base-28 digit with parabola-tangent logits (needs head bias).
d_model=2: tokens are tiny nudges on the position plane; answer position = -28*source position so the residual sum cancels position and leaves only the copied token as the high base-28 digit.
Positions carry (word, letter, phase) addresses; reversal lives in W_q as an anti-diagonal on word dims and identity on letter dims. Separator slots match any prompt separator. No pointer table.

d_model=1 with distance attention score=-(q-k)^2: position is one number, token a tiny nudge, answer position = -28*source so the sum cancels position and leaves the copied token as the high base-28 digit.
Pruned d=1 distance attention: no W_k or W_o (scalings absorbed into position spacing), 22 positions, only scalar W_q and W_v remain in the attention.
d=1 distance attention with a parameter-free tied head: logit_i = -(h - G*tok_emb_i)^2 and G=100 so the residual current token never crosses a band. 52 parameters.

Positions are real (word, letter, phase) coordinates; reversal is the affine query word' = 2 - word in W_q under distance attention. No pointer table; separators in a far column resolve to the nearest separator.
Words on one timeline (prompt 0-2, pivot 3, answer 4-6); reversal is the reflection word' = 6 - word in W_q. Drops the phase dimension from affine_mirror.
timeline_mirror without the residual: output is exactly the copied token, so G=1 and the head is plain nearest-token-embedding.
Sensitivity test of mirror_no_residual: grid spacing 2 (softer attention), predicted to fail because neighbouring tokens leak into the copied value.
Sensitivity test of mirror_no_residual: grid spacing 3, predicted to hold because neighbour leakage e^-9 times token range 27 stays under half a token.
Original architecture unchanged except n_heads=1 (LN, MLP, 3 blocks, dot attention, no head bias): W_q anti-diagonal on 7 one-hot word dims, blocks 2 and 3 are zero so they act as identity.
Original architecture with every default hyperparameter (d=64, 4 heads, 3 blocks): mirror address copied into all 4 heads so they attend identically; blocks 2 and 3 are identity.
Standard block design shrunk to what the mirror uses: d=39, 1 head, 1 block, 1-unit zero MLP, still with LayerNorm and dot attention.
Cleanest mirror: 1-number tokens, 2-column (word, letter) position table, and attention whose only parameters are the reflection word->6-word, letter->letter (4 numbers). Tied head.

Parses the string: prefix-sum attention counts separators, and word and letter addresses are linear in (t, count, is_sep). '=' acts as the third separator, so no separator special case and no address table.
Robustness probe: parser_count_sep with 2% seeded multiplicative Gaussian noise on every parameter.
Diagnosis of parser_noise02: same 2% noise, but the '=' value is re-tied to the '_' value afterwards, to test whether that tie or the address arithmetic caused the 0%.
Robustness probe: parser_count_sep with 0.2% seeded multiplicative noise and the '=' value re-tied to '_', to locate the parser's noise tolerance.
Robustness comparison: mirror_minimal (table-based addresses) under the same 2% seeded multiplicative noise that dropped parser_count_sep to 0%.
Robustness probe: mirror_minimal with 10% seeded multiplicative noise on every parameter.
Robustness probe: mirror_minimal with 5% seeded multiplicative noise on every parameter, predicted to hold since the q_bias shift stays under half a word spacing.
Word timeline centred on the '=' pivot (prompt -3..-1, answer +1..+3): reversal is a pure reflection word -> -word with no bias. Attention has just 2 parameters.
Robustness comparison: mirror_centered under the same 5% seeded noise that dropped uncentred mirror_noise05 to 0.5%.
Robustness probe: mirror_centered with 10% seeded noise (uncentred mirror_noise10 scored 0%).
Replication of centered_noise05 with noise seed 1, to check the result is not one lucky draw.
Replication of centered_noise05 with noise seed 2, to check the result is not one lucky draw.
Replication of uncentred mirror_noise05 with noise seed 1, for a fair comparison against the centred model.
Replication of uncentred mirror_noise05 with noise seed 2, for a fair comparison against the centred model.
mirror_centered with hard (argmax) attention and integer grid spacing 1: no softmax blending, so the SPACE limit seen with soft attention should vanish.
Diagnosis of centered_noise10: hard attention under 10% noise. Blending is impossible here, so a failure means addresses moved rather than softmax leaking.
Position table replaced by a fixed computed (word, letter) encoding, like a sinusoidal PE. Stored parameters: 28 token values plus the 2-number reflection. Hard attention.
Plain soft dot-product attention with circular word and letter encodings: reversal is the linear reflection W_q = beta*diag(1,-1,1,1), which turns word angle theta into -theta.
Only stored parameters are the 4 entries of W_q (the reflection). Token and position encodings and the head are fixed code, so this count understates the structure in the model.
Temperature test of reflection_only_4p: beta=10, predicted to fail because the 0.29*beta score gap lets neighbouring token values leak into the copy.
Temperature test of reflection_only_4p: beta=20, predicted to hold since the 0.29*beta gap keeps token leakage under half a token.
Diagnosis of parser_noise02_retied: hard attention with the same 2% noise. Blending is impossible, so a failure means the address arithmetic itself drifted.
